# Cncf Arks Reviewer

Review Arks using its official documentation and repository in the Inference / Framework category. Arks is an end-to-end framework for managing LLM-based applications within Kubernetes cluster. It provides a robust and extensible infrastructure tailored for deploying, orchestrating, and scaling LLM inference workloads in cloud-native environments.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
